"""Paint the reference with individually lifted straight sweeps and save robot actions."""
import os, sys, time, json, ctypes as ct
import numpy as np, cv2
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
ROOT='/app/output'
N=256
inst=json.load(open('/app/instance.json'))
pal=np.float32([w['rgb'] for w in inst['wells']['wells']]); pl=cv2.cvtColor(pal[None],cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB)[0]
target=np.float32(Image.open('/app/target.png'))/255
T=cv2.cvtColor(cv2.resize(cv2.GaussianBlur(target,(0,0),3),(N,N)),cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB)
lib=ct.CDLL(ROOT+'/planner.so');ptr=np.ctypeslib.ndpointer(dtype=np.float32,flags='C_CONTIGUOUS');lib.pick.argtypes=[ptr,ptr,ptr,ct.c_int,ct.c_int,ptr]
s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);p=s.primitives();s.record_start();wells=s.wells()
strokes=[];start=time.time()
def move(xyz,speed=.15,settle=3):
 r=p['move_tip'](xyz,speed=speed,settle=settle)
 if r['ik_failures']:print('IK failures',r,flush=True)
def draw(st):
 x,y,ang,length,width,col=st[:6]; col=int(col)
 x,y,length,width=np.array([x,y,length,width])*227.1845065/N
 dx=np.cos(ang)*length/2;dy=np.sin(ang)*length/2
 a=s.geo.mm_to_world(x-dx,y-dy);b=s.geo.mm_to_world(x+dx,y+dy)
 press=float(np.interp(width,[5.3246,7.0995,7.5432,9.0963,9.9837,11.5367],[2,3,4,5,6,8]))
 wx,wy=wells[col]['center_xy']
 move([wx,wy,.055],.25,3);move([wx,wy,.024],.1,3);move([wx,wy,.055],.15,3)
 move([*a,.045],.25,4)
 move([*a,.020-press/1000],.05,4)
 move([*b,.020-press/1000],.06,4)
 move([*b,.045],.1,3)
for i in range(440):
 canvas=s.canvas(); C=cv2.cvtColor(cv2.resize(np.float32(canvas)/255,(N,N)),cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB)
 out=np.zeros(7,np.float32); lib.pick(C,T,pl,N,i,out)
 draw(out);strokes.append(out.tolist())
 if i%20==19:
  Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(ROOT+'/canvas.png');np.save(ROOT+'/strokes.npy',np.array(strokes))
  # Save a checkpoint without interrupting the recording.
  s.save_trajectory(np.array(s._since_reset),ROOT+'/trajectory.npz')
  print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'seconds',round(time.time()-start),'gain',out[-1],flush=True)
a=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(a,ROOT+'/trajectory.npz');Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(ROOT+'/canvas.png')
np.save(ROOT+'/strokes.npy',np.array(strokes));print('SCORE',json.dumps(s.score()),flush=True)
print('SHA',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
